name: Silent Echo: Credential Harvest via Shared Modules
description:
Background

A targeted phishing campaign delivers a fileless payload that leverages shared modules for execution. Subsequent alerts reveal lateral movement, credential theft, and data exfiltration to a cloud account, culminating in a covert command-and-control channel.

Your Task

As a SOC analyst, triage the alerts in the scenario file. Identify which alerts are true positives and which are false positives. Piece together the attack story by correlating the MITRE ATT&CK techniques across the kill chain.
